notes.title: Beat the Developer's High Score, Get an Award
notes.content:
Hello!

In celebration to Cracker's release, I'm launching this small challenge: [b]Beat the Developer's High Score, Get an Award[/b].

Here's a screenshot of my Score PB:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45048289/d4da98e50dcfcd4d9271a7c822be7dd21a4120e8.png[/img]

As you can see, the score is [b]4,148,166,660[/b], or roughly 4.1 billion points. So the rules are the following:


[b]- The first 10 players to post, in the Community Hub, a screenshot of the Game Over screen with a score over [i]4,148,166,660[/i] points will receive a "Take My Points" award![/b]

[b]- You can choose any way to share the screenshot, for example: you can comment here on this post with the screenshot URL, or post it as an artwork, etc. That's up to you![/b]

[b]- This event starts now and will last for 72 hours;[/b]

[b]- Awards will be distributed either at the end of the event (if there are fewer than 10 participants) or as soon as there are 10 eligible participants; [/b]

[b]- Each player can participate only once with one score; [/b]

[b]- Players can use any character (Juntao, Jinzo, Mank or Bonzo).[/b]


Best of luck, and have fun!
